newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-INDIA SACK MANAGER PATIL, TURN TO MADAN LAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA SACK MANAGER PATIL, TURN TO MADAN LAL.

text.p: Sandeep Patil was sacked on Wednesday and replaced by ex-test
all-rounder Madan Lal, the Press Trust of India said.
Patil took over after India's semifinal defeat by Sri Lanka
in this year's World Cup, but lost a three-match test series 1-0
against England and fared modestly in three one-day tournaments
Madan Lal, a member of India's World Cup winning side in
1983, coached the United Arab Emirates team which won the ICC
Trophy to earn its first appearance at the 1996 World Cup.
